summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the new /donaspainel admin dashboard. 20/20 pytest backend tests pass (root, admin auth login/logout/me/bearer/cookie, all 5 tracking endpoints, KPIs reflect tracking, funnel, locations, activity-7days, realtime, access-list w/ query, reset-kpis). Frontend playwright flows all green: login -> dashboard with 5 KPIs + sidebar (5 nav items) + refresh + acessos modal with search + navigation between sections + logout returning to /donaspainel/login + /api/admin/auth/me returns 401 after logout. Static site (/home.html, /cadastro.html) still served correctly alongside React app at /donaspainel.
action_items: Minor naming inconsistency: agent_to_agent_context_note referenced testid 'acessos-search-input' but actual code uses 'accesses-search-input' (English). Both are fine — input works — but consider documenting the canonical naming convention.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py JWT cookie is set with secure=False — acceptable for preview but should be flagged secure=True in production HTTPS deploy.
geolocate_ip uses http://ip-api.com without rate-limiting/backoff; under load this could throttle. Cache mitigates it but consider an outbound circuit-breaker.
sum_amount() iterates all docs in Python — fine at low volume, should switch to $group/$sum aggregation when registrations scale.

AdminDashboard.jsx is a single file with charts + funnel + locations + activity + realtime + modal. At ~430 lines acceptable, but if more features are added it should be split into per-card components.
Backend reset-kpis is destructive and only protected by admin role (no double-confirm endpoint). UI does have the danger button but a server-side confirmation token might be safer.
test_credentials: Admin: donas / Seinao10@@ (from /app/backend/.env). /app/memory/test_credentials.md was not found — flagged for completeness.
seed_data_creation: Tests use POST /api/track/* to seed deterministic events and call POST /api/admin/dashboard/reset-kpis in the auth fixture to start from a clean state. After test_reset_kpis runs last, DB is empty.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses MongoDB local + JWT (HS256, 24h) with cookie 'admin_token' (httpOnly) AND Bearer token fallback. All admin endpoints accept both auth modes. Tracking endpoints are public (no auth) and used by /tracking.js injected on static pages. The /donaspainel React app coexists with static HTMLs (home.html, cadastro.html, etc) served from frontend/public. Backend_test.py is a regression-safe pytest suite — re-runnable. The reset-kpis call inside the auth fixture clears the DB; if you don't want that, set up a per-test isolation differently.
